# Maser Construction

> Maser Construction prepares permit-ready drawings, arranges architectural and MEP stamping through registered professionals, and supports building permit applications for projects across Canada. All work is handled remotely.

## Services
- Permit Drawings: https://maserconstruction.com/services/permit-drawings/
- Architectural & MEP Stamping: https://maserconstruction.com/services/architectural-mep-stamping/
- MEP Drafting & Coordination: https://maserconstruction.com/services/mep-drafting/
- Zoning Checks & Site Selection: https://maserconstruction.com/services/zoning-site-selection/
- Permit Support & Applications: https://maserconstruction.com/services/permit-support/
- Project Management & Coordination: https://maserconstruction.com/services/project-management/

## Key facts
- Serves all of Canada, fully remotely; requirements confirmed for each province and municipality before quoting
- Projects: restaurant and retail tenant improvements, commercial renovations, changes of use, residential renovations and additions
- Contact: Nik, Project Manager — 778-803-5408, contact@maserconstruction.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9:00 am–5:00 pm, Saturday 9:00 am–1:00 pm
- Free consultation and a clear fee before any work begins
